_help: Every rogue boss. The first block of fields is the One Piece Mod's own character format (see its characters.json): health, damage, Berries dropped (bounty), size, the two special attacks (power, hardPower: any of the main mod's BossAbility powers) and the Hard/Expert prizes. The rest is this mod's: hitbox ([width, height] in blocks before the size is applied, to fit its model), bountyReward (how much a first win raises your bounty), crew (an NPC kit from crews.json, or "" to fight alone), signature (the phase 3 move, see RogueSignatures.java), the lines it shouts, where its rumor drops (rumorFrom: main mod NPC kit ids) and its trophy. Optional: fruitItem (a main mod Devil Fruit dropped on a win, like its story bosses) and beasts (entity ids, one or two called with each crew wave).

bosses.name: "Saltjaw" Gully Rourke
bosses.lore: A salvage pirate who drags his ship's anchor behind him on a chain. Wrecks anything he can sell for scrap.
bosses.intro: That ship of yours'd fetch a fine price as scrap!
bosses.phase2: Lads! Strip 'em down to the nails!
bosses.phase3: Down to the seabed with ya! Anchor's away!

bosses.name: Corvina, the Fog Widow
bosses.lore: Queen of a smuggling ring that only sails in fog. Ships that follow her lanterns are never seen again.
bosses.intro: Follow the lanterns, darling. Everyone does.
bosses.phase2: Lanterns up! Let them drown in the grey.
bosses.phase3: You can't strike what you can't see!

bosses.name: Commodore Hollis "Iron Tide" Graves
bosses.lore: A Navy commodore who deserted with his whole garrison and a hold full of seastone shot. Now he sells "protection" to islands the Navy forgot.
bosses.intro: Justice is a business now. And business is good.
bosses.phase3: Seastone volley! Let's see that fruit save you now!

bosses.name: Tsurugi, the Hollow Ronin
bosses.lore: An empty suit of samurai armor that still fights. Whoever wore it swore to duel until they lost, and never lost.
bosses.phase3: Hollow Cut. There is nothing left inside to stop it.

bosses.name: Boilerheart Gantz
bosses.lore: A shipbreaker who rebuilt himself around a ship's boiler. He eats coal, breathes steam and tears warships apart by hand.
bosses.phase3: PRESSURE'S PAST THE RED! EVERYBODY DOWN!

bosses.name: Nereus Vane, Herald of the Deep
bosses.lore: A fishman prophet who says the sea itself speaks through him. His followers sink ships as offerings to something far below.
bosses.intro: The deep has been waiting for you.
bosses.phase3: Tidal Judgment! Let the sea take back what's hers!

bosses.name: Gild Tesoro, the Golden Emperor
bosses.lore: Owner of the Gran Tesoro, a casino-ship as big as a country. The Gold-Gold Fruit lets him command any gold he has touched, and everyone aboard has touched his gold.
bosses.intro: Welcome to the Gran Tesoro! Tonight, the house always wins.
bosses.phase2: Security! Escort our guest to the gold vault... permanently.
bosses.phase3: Gold Gold Finale! Become a statue in my collection!
bosses.defeat: Impossible... I paid for this ending...

bosses.name: Uta, the World's Diva
bosses.lore: The world's most beloved singer. Anyone who hears her Sing-Sing Fruit song falls asleep into Uta World, a dream she never means to let them leave.
bosses.intro: Everyone listen! This next song is just for you!
bosses.phase2: My fans won't let you ruin the concert!
bosses.phase3: Tot Musica... play the final song with me!

bosses.name: "Z", Admiral Zephyr of the Neo Marines
bosses.lore: A former Navy Admiral who never ate a fruit and trained a generation of Marines. Now he leads the Neo Marines with a seastone arm, the Battle Smasher, to end the Pirate Era for good.
bosses.intro: Pirates... every last one of you will be wiped out.
bosses.phase2: Neo Marines! Show them what real justice looks like!
bosses.phase3: Battle Smasher! Feel the seastone, pirate!
bosses.defeat: So this... is the new era...

bosses.name: Douglas Bullet, the Demon Heir
bosses.lore: A former Roger Pirate who only believes in strength. The Clank-Clank Fruit fuses every scrap of metal around him into armour, and then into a war machine as big as a castle.
bosses.intro: Show me if you're strong. The weak don't get to live in my world.
bosses.phase2: Not enough! Hit me like you mean it!
bosses.phase3: Clank-Clank! Gashapon Fortress! Can you break THIS?!

bosses.name: Shiki, the Golden Lion
bosses.lore: The legendary pirate who broke out of Impel Down by cutting off his own legs; swords stand in their place. The Float-Float Fruit lifts his islands into the sky, where his mutated beasts wait.
bosses.intro: Jihahaha! So you're the brat making waves down there!
bosses.phase2: Come, my beasts! Supper's flown in!
bosses.phase3: Shishi Ikari! The sky itself falls on you!
